assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code I48.0 is assigned for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code I47.1 is assigned for supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment
The clinical indication note confirms that this monitoring is necessary to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
